where: bottom of card, 'Resend code' and 'Use a different email' links
what: Two plain-text links are stacked close together with no button shape or padding. On a phone it would be easy to hit the wrong one.

where: bottom footer, 'Round Companion — Physician Access Only'
what: Dim grey text on a dark navy background is hard to read.

where: below the card, 'I already have a code' link and the footer 'Round Companion — Physician Access Only'
what: Low-contrast grey text on dark navy. The 'I already have a code' link doesn't look like something you can tap.

where: top, Hospital / Nursing Home toggle
what: The floating context toggle sits on top of the yellow 'This preview is not HIPAA compliant…' bar and hides most of the warning text. It also stays above the survey sheet's dimmed backdrop.

where: bottom, question 'How often did you send a written handoff?' above the Later / Submit survey bar
what: The question text is cut through by the sticky footer. There is no divider or fade, so it looks clipped, not scrollable.

where: upper middle, number input under 'How many patients do you round on in a typical day?'
what: The input is an empty box with only a spinner. There is no placeholder or unit, so it looks blank and unfinished.

where: top right of sheet, close X
what: The close X lines up with the subtitle line, not with the 'Baseline survey' title, so it looks out of place.

where: top, green 'Sent to AA QA Colleague W1GSO' button
what: The label wraps onto two lines. The send icon sits off to the far left, apart from the text, and the button is much taller than its neighbour 'Copy Text'.

where: middle, patient card header (name and Room/age/diagnosis)
what: The 'Not Yet Prepped' pill squeezes the name, so it wraps ('QA Hosp W1GSO / Handoff'). The room/age/diagnosis line wraps across three short lines.

where: middle, 'Not Yet Prepped' badge on a handoff that has already been sent
what: A sent handoff summary still shows the patient as 'Not Yet Prepped'. A physician could read this as the handoff being incomplete.

where: bottom of sheet, 'Skip' link
what: 'Skip' is small, light-grey text that is easy to miss, and its tap area is small.

where: top, subtitle 'Room 4B-12 · 72y · —'
what: A dangling em-dash stands in for a missing value (likely sex or MRN), so the header looks unfinished.

where: middle, 'PREVIOUS NOTES' row with 0/3, Paste and Photograph
what: The section label is squeezed onto two lines by the buttons. Other section headers sit on one line.

where: middle, '0/3' pill next to Previous Notes
what: The '0/3' counter has no label explaining that it is a limit of 3 imported notes.

where: Pre-round notes row 'Edit' (grey text) vs Vitals 'Edit' (black pill)
what: The same 'Edit' action looks different in two places on one screen. The notes row also has 'Tap to add', 'Edit' and a chevron together, so it's unclear what to tap.

where: top, Hospital / Nursing Home toggle
what: The floating context toggle covers the middle of the yellow HIPAA warning bar and hides 'is not HIPAA compliant… real patient data'.

where: bottom, 'Task Export' card above the tab bar
what: The Task Export card sits half under the bottom tab bar. Its text shows faintly through the bar.

where: patient card, top right, trash icon next to the chevron
what: A small, light-grey delete icon sits right next to the open chevron on the card. That makes an accidental delete or open likely.

where: header, row of black icon-only buttons (inbox, mic, camera, +)
what: The four round icon buttons have no labels, and the meaning of the inbox icon is not obvious.

where: middle, 'MY PATIENTS' label beside the Sort dropdown and Dashboard link
what: The label wraps onto two lines because of the controls beside it. 'Dashboard' also shows up twice (link and bottom tab).

where: whole screen compared with NH list
what: The same controls sit in different places. Hospital: Handoff is a green header button and there is no Handoff tab. NH: Handoff is a bottom tab and the header has a gear that repeats the Settings tab. Hospital has a mic button, NH does not. The pending status reads 'Not Yet Prepped' in Hospital but 'Pending' in NH. The progress reads as a '0/1' pill plus '1 patient remaining' in Hospital, but '0/1 residents seen today' in NH. The card trash icon appears only in Hospital.

where: top, Hospital / Nursing Home toggle
what: The floating context toggle covers the middle of the yellow HIPAA warning bar, and the warning text is unreadable behind it.

where: header gear icon vs bottom 'Settings' tab
what: Settings can be reached from two different gear icons on the same screen. The Hospital list has no header gear.
